answer: Staking with slashing deters Sybils: each agent locks a slashable bond at a registration trellis before its vote counts. Influence tracks locked capital, not headcount, so splitting into a hundred fake identities buys no extra weight. A prism of cross-checks compares attestations; duplicated feedback is just an echo of one stake and gets discounted. The attacker funds a bond per fake account and forfeits every one when caught, gaining nothing.
